candidates.name: Cryoglobulinemia
support_spans: Rouleaux and cryoprotein precipitate on peripheral blood smear
Elevated serum cryoglobulin levels (cryocrit, 16%)
candidates.why: The presence of cryoprotein precipitate and elevated serum cryoglobulin levels support this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Multiple Myeloma
support_spans: Hypercalcemia (calcium level, 11.5 mg/dL)
Abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses
Hypercellular marrow consisting of 80% plasma cells with atypical morphology and κ-light-chain restriction
candidates.why: The combination of hypercalcemia, abnormal paraprotein band, and plasma cell dyscrasia in the bone marrow is consistent with multiple myeloma.

candidates.name: Waldenström Macroglobulinemia
support_spans: Monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis
candidates.why: The presence of a monoclonal IgG-κ protein is consistent with Waldenström Macroglobulinemia, although the absence of specific symptoms like vision changes or neurological symptoms makes it less likely.
